title: Fourier Analysis
text: Discrete or continuous time Fourier analysis, 1 input, 2 outputs, {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} sets Block sample time; {Fundamental frequency (Hz)} sets the signal fundamental frequency, {Harmonic numbers} sets the signal harmonic numbers, {Initial magnitude} sets the initial signal magnitude, {Initial phase (rad)} sets the initial signal phase and {Buffer size}. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Fundamental frequency (Hz)
params.values: Signal fundamental frequency 60 (default) | positive scalar | vector with positive values

params.name: Harmonic numbers
params.values: Signal harmonic numbers [1 2] (default) | vector with elements ≥ 0

params.name: Initial magnitude
params.values: Initial signal magnitude 1 (default) | vector with elements ≥ 0
